title: nwjl.3: C: add claim_seq field to slot claims and NVS-backed replay cache

Add u32 claim_seq to struct lichen_slot_claim, include in signature transcript, implement per-gateway-IID NVS replay cache. NOTE: overlaps with l1qw.20.1 — coordinate or merge.
